caption: The drawing depicts a single, transparent glass bottle with a round body, a narrow neck, a curved handle attached to one side, and a round-topped stopper inserted at the top. The glass has a slight greenish tint and is rendered with clear highlights and reflections, indicating light sources and the shiny nature of the material. The reflections suggest window-shaped light sources. The handle is thick and extends from the upper neck to the shoulder of the bottle. The neck is long and cylindrical, tapering slightly before flaring out at the mouth where the stopper fits. The bottle sits centrally against a plain, light-colored background with no additional objects or detail. The base of the bottle is wider and curves inward towards the bottom. There is a signature in the lower right corner that reads "Bob Stewart."
title: Blown Decanter
